name: GStore Shortcodes
author: GMETI

sections.description:
Companion plugin for the GStore theme. It adds shortcodes that use the theme’s own design and texts. It only works with GStore active.

Home page: [gstore_categories] [gstore_tiles cats="slug1,slug2"] [gstore_row title="..." cat="slug" type="featured|sale|new" limit="10" link=""] [gstore_link page="shop" text="..."] [gstore_email]

Header and footer (Elementor Header & Footer Builder): [gstore_burger] [gstore_deliver] [gstore_search] [gstore_lang] [gstore_account] [gstore_orders] [gstore_cart] [gstore_nav] [gstore_menu location="footer_1"] [gstore_footer_cats] [gstore_pay_icons] [gstore_year] [gstore_breadcrumb]

The plugin does not connect to any external service and does not collect data.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the GStore theme.
  2. In Plugins › Add New Plugin, search for GStore Shortcodes, install it and activate it.
  3. Add the shortcodes to your pages or to your Elementor header and footer templates.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • First release: the shortcodes that were part of the GStore theme.
